title: Isolation of exosomal RNA from cell culture supernatant using the System Biosciences Exoquick Seramir tissue culture kit
protocol: Harvest cell culture medium from 80% confluent cells grown in serum-free medium.
Spin media at 500-1,000 x g for 10 min (optional).
Centrifuge medium at 2000 x g for 10 min and filter using a 0.22 µm PES Steriflip membrane.
Freeze pre-cleared medium at -80°C until needed.
Thaw 4 mL of cell culture supernatant on ice.
Add 0.8 mL of Exoquick-TC to the supernatant and mix by inversion 3 times.
Centrifuge at 16,000 x g for 2 min, remove supernatant, and keep exosome pellet.
Add 350 µL Lysis buffer to the exosome pellet, vortex for 15 s, and incubate at room temperature for 5 min.
Add 200 µL of 100% ethanol to the lysed sample and vortex for 10 s.
Transfer 600 µL to spin column and centrifuge at 16,000 x g for 1 min.
Add 400 µL of wash buffer to the column and centrifuge at 16,000 x g for 1 min, then discard flow-through.
Repeat step with additional 400 µL of wash buffer.
Centrifuge column at 16,000 x g for 2 min to dry the column.
Transfer spin column to a new collection tube and add 14 µL or 30 µL RNase-free water directly to the membrane.
Centrifuge at 400 x g for 2 min.
Centrifuge at 16,000 x g for 1 min.
